title: Exact values of rainbow Turán numbers for fan graphs and even wheel graphs
summary: An edge-colored graph is called rainbow if all its edges have distinct colors. For a fixed graph $H$, the rainbow Turán number $\exstar(n, H)$ is the maximum number of edges in a properly edge-colored graph with $n$ vertices that does not contain a rainbow subgraph isomorphic to $H$. A $t$-fan $\Ft$ ($t \geq 2$) is a graph formed by $t$ triangles sharing a common vertex. A wheel graph $\Wn$ is constructed by connecting a new vertex $x$ to all vertices of a cycle $\Cn$ with $n$ vertices. Keevash, Mubayi, Sudakov, Verstraëte~({\small Combin. Probab.
